name: New Items (sample)
description: Sample for kiln.content's new items and recipes (Forge's DeferredRegister): a Frost Edge sword and Frost Shards with two hand-crafting recipes, from code, plus a Frost Lantern from a data pack, and a perk and a buff of its own (kiln.gamedata clones: Frostbite Edge on Glacier applies Frostbite; /frostbite tries the buff; /wearfrost puts Frost Mail on through the game's own equip). Install it on the server and on every player's game (side both): ids come from fixed GUIDs, so both sides agree, and the client shows the names, icons and recipes.
